name: Orbit — Portfolio & Radar
description: This site: a personal portfolio bank and a self-updating news radar across AI, Data, and Delivery, with a built-in Studio for editing content and publishing projects.

name: Ultimate Reel Maker
description: A self-hosted topic-to-video pipeline: local TTS (Kokoro), word-level captions (Whisper.cpp), Pexels B-roll, and Remotion composition — with Ollama-powered script generation.

name: ProjectHelm (JARVIS)
description: A local control plane for a personal AI assistant — a meta-orchestrator that tracks project state, coordinates child agents, and runs Plan → Agent → Debug loops via the Cursor SDK.

name: ProjectBrain
description: A personal project-intelligence system that learns across projects over time, extracts patterns from success and failure, and serves low-latency context to AI coding agents via MCP.

name: Faceless Reels
description: An automated short-form video pipeline for Greek-mythology reels: beat-split narration, AI image generation with a quality loop, neural TTS, and karaoke-style captions.

name: Career Dashboard
description: A personal CV and career-path dashboard with a public/private split — build a CV-only public site while keeping career plans and learning tracks private.

name: Viral Arcade Dash
description: A deterministic 2D endless runner with an "engine-less cartridge" architecture — game rules isolated from the Expo + Skia shell, gated by a determinism + ship verification loop.

name: Sunplot Garden
description: A cozy mobile gardening game (Unity) built as a studio repo with an agent-driven content pipeline and a vertical-grid layout system.
